headlines.title: 7월 ‘ 부동산 증세 ’ 사실상 공식화 [이슈&뷰]
headlines.summary: ‘보유·양도세 강화’ 세제개편안 가닥 종부세율·공정시장가액비율도 손질 반도체發 유동성 부동산 유입 차단 오는 7월 말 발표될 세제개편안에는 부동산 보유세와 양도소득세를 강화하는 방안이 담길 것으로 전망된다.

headlines.summary: ■ ‘부동산 증세’에 안정성 악화 전세가율 17개월만에 오름세 “보유세 인상, 세입자에게 전가” 15일 오전 불암산 전망대에서 바라본 노원구 아파트 단지들. 박윤슬 기자 정부가 부동산 증세를 사실상 기정사실화한 가운데 서울 아파트 전세가 상승률이 매매가 상승률을 앞질러 임대차 시장 불안감이 증폭되고 있다.

headlines.title: “ 월세, 반년만 두배 폭등 ”… 서울 156만원 ‘ 역대 최고 ’ [부동산 증세...
headlines.summary: 5월 월세 1년전보다 10.6% 급상승 ‘월세 300만원 이상’ 작년보다 2%P↑ “보유세 강화 땐 전·월세난 더 심화” #. 강동구 둔촌동에 소재한 올림픽파크포레온 84㎡는 지난 1월 15일 보증금 1억원·월세 150만원에 월세 계약이 이뤄졌다.

headlines.title: 경매도 뜨겁다, 시세보다 수천만원 비싸도 낙찰
headlines.summary: 동탄구, 감정가보다 낙찰가 높아 경기도 화성시 동탄 아파트 단지 전경 모습. /오종찬 기자 삼성전자 성과급과 증시 활황 등의 여파로 경기 화성시 동탄의 아파트 가격이 단시간 내에 가파르게 오르면서 이 지역 아파트 경매 시장도 활발해지고 있다.

headlines.title: 블룸버그 "MSCI 신흥시장 4년만 의 깜짝실적 …삼전닉스 등 주도"
headlines.summary: 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스를 비롯한 한국 반도체 기업들이 신흥시장(EM) 기업들의 4년 만의 이익 반등을 이끌며 글로벌 강세장의 핵심 동력으로 떠오르고 있다고 블룸버그 통신이 현지시각 21일 보도했습니다. 블룸버그에 따르면 MSCI(모건스탠리캐피털인터내셔널) 신흥시장 지수 편입 기업들의 가중 평균 주당순이익(EPS)은 지난달까지 12개월 기준 95.

headlines.title: 반도체 슈퍼랠리로 수출 호황 … 역대급 실적 뒤 ‘ K-양극화 ’
headlines.summary: 620억 달러 중 반도체비중 41% 승용차 2.3% 증가로 제자리걸음 6월 중순까지 수출이 반도체 호황에 힘입어 동 기간 기준 역대 최대를 기록했다. 다만 반도체를 제외한 주력 품목은 제자리걸음에 그치면서 ‘K자 양극화’가 굳어지는 모습이다. 관세청이 22일 발표한 ‘6월 1∼20일 수출입 현황(잠정치)’에 따르면 이 기간 수출액은 전년 동기 대비 60.

headlines.title: K-뷰티·건자재 …“ 전쟁 끝, 마진 회복할까 ”
headlines.summary: 올해 중기 4대 소비재 수출 16.4%↑ K-뷰티 40억9000만달러 역대 1위도 나프타 수급 회복·유가 하락 기대중 미국과 이란의 종전 합의 소식에 원자재 공급난으로 어려움을 겪었던 건자재 업종 기업들도 실적 회복을 기대하고 있다.  사진은 플라스틱 포장재가 전시된 서울 시내 한 시장 업체 모습.

headlines.title: 전기요금 3분기 도 동결 …한전 재무 부담 지속
headlines.summary: 한국전력 본사 전경 정부가 올해 3분기(7~9월) 전기요금을 동결했다. 국제 연료가격 하락으로 연료비조정단가 인하 요인이 발생했지만, 한국전력공사의 재무 상황과 미조정 요금을 고려한 조치다. 물가 안정과 국민 부담 완화에는 도움이 되지만, 한전 재무정상화와 전력망 투자 재원 확보 과제는 계속 숙제로 남게 됐다.

headlines.title: 3분기 전기요금 도 ' 동결 ' 유력…폭염 속 커지는 한전 '역마진' 경고등
headlines.summary: 한전, 22일 7~9월 연료비 조정단가 발표…kWh당 +5원 유지 전망 무더위 예고에 전력판매는 확대될 듯…발묶인 요금에 팔수록 손해 1일 서울의 상권거리에 전기계량기가 설치돼 있다. 이날부터 자영업자들이 주로 사용하는 일반용전력에도 '낮에는 싸고, 밤에는 비싼' 시간대별 전기요금제가 확대 적용된다.

headlines.title: 정년 연장 · 집단소송 확대 … “또 기업 옥죄기 법안” 재계 한숨
headlines.summary: 與, 7~8월 정년 65세 입법 추진 의무공개매수제 등 법제화 대기 배임죄 완화 등 ‘당근’은 하세월 인건비 상승·채용 축소 가능성 기업 경쟁력 약화 부작용 우려 의석 179석을 지킨 채 국회 후반기를 맞은 범여권이 친노동 및 경영권 규제 강화 법안 처리를 예고하고 있어 산업계가 초긴장하고 있다.

headlines.title: [Why&Next] 고용유지지원금 , 대상 2배 늘었지만 수급액·기간 ' 뚝 '
headlines.summary: 기간 2.5→2.1개월 지원금 117→85만원 "제도 상시화에 지원효과 희석 우려도" 올해 고용유지지원금이 지급 대상이 2배 이상 늘어난 반면에 수급 기간과 수급액은 감소한 것으로 나타났다. 지원 대상을 넓히는 대신 개별 수급 규모가 줄어들면서, 고용유지지원금이 실질적 고용안전망에 대한 실효성 약화 우려가 제기된다.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Monthly Rent Doubles in Six Months, Hits All-Time High of 1.56 Million Won
key_headlines.summary: Monthly rent prices in Seoul have surged 10.6% year-over-year in May, with premium apartments exceeding 3 million won monthly rent increasing by 2 percentage points. Government plans to strengthen property holding and transfer taxes in July, raising concerns about further rental market deterioration.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Super Rally Drives Record Exports, But K-Economy Shows Polarization
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's exports hit record highs in mid-June led by semiconductors comprising 41% of total 62 billion dollar exports, while main industries like automobiles show stagnation at 2.3% growth. The widening gap between semiconductor and other sectors reflects deepening K-shaped economic polarization.

key_headlines.title: July Property Tax Increase Measures Officially Taking Shape
key_headlines.summary: The government plans to strengthen property holding tax and capital gains tax in a tax reform plan to be announced in late July, aiming to block semiconductor-generated liquidity from flowing into real estate. The measures include adjustments to comprehensive property tax rates and fair market value ratios.

key_headlines.title: Jeonse (Lease Deposit) Prices Rise as Renters Struggle with Loan Restrictions
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment jeonse price increases are outpacing sales price increases for the first time in 17 months, with rental market instability intensifying amid government property tax strengthening announcements. Rising jeonse prices are being passed on to tenants, creating additional hardship.

key_headlines.title: National Apartment Market Shows Simultaneous Rising Trend in Both Sales and Jeonse
key_headlines.summary: 16 out of 17 provinces nationwide show synchronized increases in both apartment sales and jeonse prices, with Seoul recording the highest weekly jeonse appreciation rate in a year. The broad-based price increases signal a complete sellers' market across the nation.

sections.Hot Economy News: Seoul monthly rent prices have doubled in six months, reaching an all-time high of 1.56 million won, with year-over-year increases of 10.6% in May. Semiconductor exports are driving record-breaking economic performance, with semiconductors accounting for 41% of June mid-month exports valued at 62 billion dollars, yet this success masks significant polarization as other major industries like automobiles stagnate with only 2.3% growth. The government is preparing to strengthen property holding and capital gains taxes in July as announced tax reform measures, raising concerns about amplified rental market instability and potential negative impacts on renters. National apartment markets show simultaneous price increases in both sales and jeonse across 16 of 17 provinces, indicating a comprehensive sellers' market with Seoul recording the highest weekly jeonse appreciation in one year.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Fiscal experts are urging the government to allocate record tax revenues toward future investments and establish contingency funds rather than expanding current expenditures, particularly given uncertainties around semiconductor industry sustainability and future economic conditions. Government officials acknowledge heightened fiscal management uncertainty stemming from semiconductor cycle dependency, volatile tax flow forecasts, and potential inflation and interest rate fluctuations. Wage-driven inflation pressures are intensifying with time lags, creating concerns about triple hardship for low-income households including self-employed individuals who report deteriorating economic sentiment despite positive macro indicators. The government is pursuing structural reforms of mandatory expenditures, which are rigidly increasing by law beyond discretionary spending adjustments. China has maintained its base rate at record lows for 13 consecutive months amid internal domestic and export polarization, with May nationwide urban unemployment improving slightly to 5.1% from 5.2%.
sections.Financial Markets: Domestic stock investors are optimistic about KOSPI reaching 10,000 this year, with interest rates and exchange rates identified as the most critical variables affecting second-half market performance at 58.7%, followed by crude oil prices and inflation at 12.3%. Despite KOSPI surpassing 9,000, approximately 8% of domestic listed companies are trading as penny stocks below 1,000 won, with 219 penny stock issues identified as of mid-June, prompting Korean stock exchange investor caution notices. Crude oil prices have experienced dramatic decline of approximately 30% over a month (Dubai crude falling from 106 to 73 dollars), though domestic gas prices show typical 2-3 week lag in reflecting global price changes. Key market focus has shifted to corporate earnings and semiconductor company performance, particularly Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, following resolution of Middle East risks and FOMC events. US Federal Reserve's removal of forward guidance may lead to interest rate increases, creating uncertainty for Korean markets heavily dependent on rate and currency fluctuations.
sections.Industry & Technology: Hyundai Mobis is expanding beyond automotive components into robotics and semiconductors, leveraging its design capabilities and mass production experience to develop sensor, controller, and battery components for the robot industry. Manufacturing sector outlooks for July show decline for the first time in three months except for semiconductor and automotive sectors which maintain strength above baseline indicators. LG Energy Solution is showcasing AI data center battery solutions at the ees Europe 2026 exhibition in Munich, featuring integrated battery systems addressing power demands of AI data centers including grid-scale energy storage systems, uninterruptible power supplies, and battery backup units. A Taiwanese brother-sister team betting on automotive display semiconductors have become billionaires after founding HiMax in 2001, achieving 40% global market share through supplies to Ferrari and Porsche and planning smart glasses investments.
sections.Real Estate: Nationwide apartment markets display synchronized price increases across 16 of 17 provinces with both sales and jeonse prices rising, with Seoul recording year-high weekly jeonse appreciation rates. Jeonse prices are rising faster than sales prices for the first time in 17 months, indicating rental market destabilization as government property tax increases are anticipated to be passed to tenants. Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon's reelection victory signals momentum for reconstruction projects, potentially fast-tracking some urban regeneration initiatives. Samsung C&T has secured construction rights for Gaepou Woosong 4th reconstruction project in Gangnam District, involving 459 households being reconstructed into 1,045 units with total project cost of 814.5 billion won. Government property tax policy discussions continue regarding conditional exemptions for landlords maintaining rental price increases within 5% limits during contract renewals.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve reversed its interest rate outlook from one cut to one rate hike this year at its recent meeting, with new Fed Chair Walsh indicating potential removal of forward guidance tools, prompting expert warnings about rising interest rate expectations. The removal of forward guidance by the Fed may increase uncertainty in global markets and elevate borrowing costs for Korean companies reliant on US financial conditions. K-beauty continues expanding in European markets beyond North America, with Korean cosmetics achieving growing market share in major European countries particularly in skincare and makeup categories. MK Electronics successfully participated in NEPCON China 2026 and NEPCON Thailand 2026, advancing global customer expansion for solder paste business in electronics and semiconductor manufacturing. The Iran conflict has generated significant US Defense Department costs at approximately 61 trillion won, with energy price increases from war generating inflationary pressures affecting Fed monetary policy decisions.
sections.AI & Economy: PwC's 2026 AI Jobs Barometer report analyzing over 1 billion job postings across 27 countries indicates AI is catalyzing labor market polarization beyond simple job displacement, widening gaps between specialized positions requiring human expertise and judgment versus automated routine tasks. GrowthResearch predicts a supercycle in power equipment industry as AI data center infrastructure development creates new transmission and distribution network construction demand alongside existing North American aging grid replacement projects. FSN is transforming from advertising agency-focused business model to brand, platform, and AI content-centered company through revenue structure improvements and financial health strengthening, establishing high-value-added business portfolio. Korea Aerospace Industries is launching financial cooperation with NH Bank to strengthen Korean defense industry competitiveness through facility investments, new business expansion, and export growth financing. Defense venture investment reached 19 trillion won year-to-date including drone, autonomous vessel, and battlefield AI technologies amid ongoing geopolitical conflicts.
sections.Others: Woori Tahnos Securities launched AI-based personalized investment information service 'AI PB' expanding beyond chatbot and news summary functions to provide customized investment insights through its trading platform. Majority of Israeli respondents (90%) identify Iran as war victor, expressing negative views toward US-Iran ceasefire agreement with 48.2% willing to accept conflict with Trump administration over continued Hezbollah military operations. China imposed wholesale sanctions on US rare earth, defense, and technology companies amid ongoing economic trade negotiations, raising concerns about potential tariff retaliation impacts. KOTRA (Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency) achieved 'A' rating in 2025 public institution management evaluation by the Ministry of Finance and Economy, continuing its mission supporting Korean trade and investment since 1962.
